prompts.name: 裂岩妖狼
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Chinese cultivation RPG enemy sprite sheet, refined painterly game illustration, detailed realistic animal anatomy, no text, no borders, no ground, transparent alpha background. Exactly EIGHT fully separated full-body depictions of the SAME creature, arranged in 4 columns by 2 rows, each within its own equal cell with ample transparent padding. All face RIGHT in clear three-quarter side view. Row1: idle stance; attack anticipation crouch; lunging strike; attack follow-through. Row2: guarding stance; recoiling from hit; stumbling withdrawal; defeated lying on side (non-gory). Consistent size, colors, identity, lighting. Every limb remains anatomically attached and accounted for, no duplicate limbs. Show complete extremities within frame. Creature: powerful slate-grey wolf, coarse silver fur, angular natural dark stone plates across shoulders and back with restrained amber cracks, amber eyes, one bushy tail, exactly four legs with four canine paws, two ears. Lean wild wolf muzzle, not tiger or dog armor.
